      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author downgraded startup notice from warning to info",

      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Where does preserving block file timestamps become relevant?",

      "status_by_id": "rc:3436172644",
      "status_by_quote": "Was explicitly requested to minimize unintended changes"

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Mark the kernel notification for reobfuscation progress as resumable",
      "quote": "Could this be the first kernel notification where resume is possible?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author marked GUI reobfuscation progress as resumable",
      "author_replies": ["r:4525334593", "rc:3436260312"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:4525334593",
      "status_by_quote": "Marked GUI reobfuscation progress as resumable and reused a single translated progress title."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3637087440",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Asserting on filesystem operations aborts the node on exceptional runtime conditions instead of returning or throwing errors",
      "quote": "It does feel a bit weird to me to assert on what is not an invariant of the program, but rather an exceptional condition. Why not just throw or return here",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "filesystem failures now propagate instead of aborting on assertions",

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3649809000",
      "status_by_quote": "filesystem failures now propagate instead of aborting on assertions."

The migration logic looks nice, and while a C++ standalone utility would be a good candidate later, the PR should not be blocked on pioneering GUI launching and lock handling.
I still think the change is good, but this has not gotten a lot of review interest in the year it has been open, and I feel like the feature probably looses relevance over time.
